    IC39 Non-Response Intelligence

    Triggered after two sessions without improvement
    Cause 1
    Substrate Adequacy
    Are basic terrain support inputs sufficient?
    + expand
    Review whether foundational nutritional, hydration, and sleep substrates meet minimum thresholds before escalating investigation tier. Check FLINT™ L1 node burden scores for assimilation (N1) and energy (N3) markers. If substrate inputs are adequate, proceed to Cause 2.
    Cause 2
    Hidden Driver
    Is a VOLTERRAIN driver active that was not in the initial inventory?
    + expand
    Consider environmental exposures, stealth infections, or undisclosed stressors not captured in the initial terrain assessment. DRD™ designation: Driver. Review whether cascade stacks have shifted since baseline. S4 THEORETICAL (excluded from DRD trace D-12). S6 UNIDIRECTIONAL: Z1 to Z3 only.
    Cause 3
    Compliance
    Is the patient executing terrain support as agreed?
    + expand
    Assess adherence to Personalised Terrain Management Protocol (T-01). Include supplement timing, dietary modifications, and lifestyle adjustments. Non-compliance is the most common cause of non-response and should be explored without judgement.
    Cause 4
    Archetype Re-check
    Was the original terrain configuration accurate?
    + expand
    Re-evaluate the initial terrain configuration pattern. Zone thresholds: Z1 to Z4 = 40 internal, Z5 = 32 internal (lower: hormonal sensitivity). If the original pattern was misclassified, the cascade stack directions may have been incorrectly weighted.
    IC39 is practitioner-mediated. CADENCE is Phase 2 algorithmic. They are architecturally distinct.

    TerrainSpiral™ Terrain Trajectory Assessment

    INTERNAL ONLY: The four trajectory state names below are internal working labels. Practitioner-facing descriptor: "terrain trajectory assessment" only per D-179.
    Card 1
    Stabilising
    Burden reducing, terrain responding. Zone scores trending toward threshold or below.
    APEX budget modifier: MAINTAIN current tier.
    Card 2
    Progressively Destabilising
    Worsening trajectory. APEX™ tier escalates. Review cascade stack activation and DRD™ designation (Driver).
    APEX budget modifier: ESCALATE to next tier.
    Card 3
    Acutely Destabilising
    Rapid deterioration. Investigate trigger immediately. Consider IC39 non-response review if applicable.
    APEX budget modifier: ESCALATE immediately. Tier 3 investigation warranted.
    Card 4
    Locked
    TerrainLock™ conditions met. Self-perpetuating loop: Z2 to Z1 to Z5 to Z2 (S1 + S2 + S4). S4 THEORETICAL. S6 UNIDIRECTIONAL: Z1 to Z3 only.
    APEX budget modifier: ESCALATE. TerrainLock™ requires targeted cascade disruption strategy.

    Synthesis Layer: Seven Sequential Gates

    G1
    Safety Override (C79)
    Checks for contraindications, interaction flags, and W08 regulatory gates before any output is generated.
    Runs first, always.
    G2
    FLINT™ Pipeline Output
    Receives L1 through L5 layer outputs. Node scores, zone composites, cascade stacks, DRD™ designation (Driver), APEX™ sequencing.
    G3
    Active Subset and Ranked Display
    Filters to active zones only (above threshold: Z1 to Z4 = 40, Z5 = 32). Ranks by burden. S4 THEORETICAL excluded from ranking trace (D-12).
    G4
    Terrain Configuration Pattern
    Determines the terrain configuration from active zone combination. S6 UNIDIRECTIONAL: Z1 to Z3 only. TerrainLock™ detection at this gate.
    G5
    Intervention Tolerance
    Assesses terrain absorption capacity (GRADE™ state). Adjusts Personalised Terrain Management Protocol intensity accordingly.
    G6
    APEX™ Priority Sequence
    Orders investigation priorities by cascade-weighted urgency. Three budget tiers: GBP 200 to 400 (Tier 1), GBP 400 to 800 (Tier 2), GBP 800+ (Tier 3).
    G7
    Synthesis Confidence Score
    Calculates overall confidence from evidence tier distribution across all inputs. Carries the tier of the lowest-evidence input.
    Evidence tier floor rule: output carries the tier of the lowest-evidence input.
    No-write-back: Synthesis Layer does not write back into L1 through L5. Read-only consumption of FLINT™ pipeline outputs.

        Z2: Resilience Network
